edges.target_label: From Pixels to States: World Models as Game Engines (2026)
edges.note: Where World Models learn an implicit latent recurrent state to predict observations, this paper argues for an explicit rule-following game state that persists over long horizons and supplies ground-truth states to train and measure against.

edges.target_label: From Pixels to States: World Models as Game Engines (2026)
edges.note: Where Navigation World Models condition prediction on actions for navigation, this paper reframes the target as a game engine's action-state-observation loop and releases a dataset with ground-truth states.

edges.target_label: From Pixels to States: World Models as Game Engines (2026)
edges.note: Offline RL is the reference for learning from logged interaction without live rollouts; this paper supplies over 90 hours of logged gameplay with frame-aligned actions and ground-truth states for state-aware world modeling.
